arabic_text: فَمَنْ اَرادَ الْمَدينَةَ وَ الْحِكْمَةَ فَلْيَاْتِها مِنْ بابِها ثُمَّ قالَ : اَنْتَ اَخي وَ وَصِيّي وَ وارِثي لَحْمُكَ مِنْ لَحْمي وَ دَمُكَ مِنْ دَمي وَ سِلْمُكَ سِلْمي وَ حَرْبُكَ حَرْبي وَ الإيمانُ مُخالِطٌ لَحْمَكَ وَ دَمَكَ كَما خالَطَ لَحْمي وَ دَمي
transliteration: faman arada al-madinah wa al-hikmah falyatiha min babiha thumma qala: anta akhi wa wasiyyi wa warithi laḥmuka min laḥmī wa damuka min damī wa silmuka silmī wa ḥarbu-ka ḥarby wa al-īmānu mukhāliṭun laḥmaka wa damaka kamā khālaṭa laḥmī wa damī
english_text: Whoso desires to approach and dwell in the city of knowledge and wisdom should come through its door." Thereafter he said: "You are my brother, successor and inheritor, your flesh is my flesh, your blood is my blood, your truce is my truce, your fight is my fight, faith is blended, mixed and mingled (part and parcel) in your flesh and blood, just as it is compounded in my flesh and blood,

arabic_text: وَ اَنْتَ غَداً عَلَى الْحَوْضِ خَليفَتي وَ اَنْتَ تَقْضي دَيْني وَ تُنْجِزُ عِداتي وَ شيعَتُكَ عَلى مَنابِرَ مِنْ نُورٍ مُبْيَضَّةً وُجُوهُهُمْ حَوْلي فِي الْجَنَّةِ وَ هُمْ جيراني
transliteration: wa anta ghadan ʿalal-ḥawḍi khalīfatī wa anta taqḍi daynī wa tunjizu ʿīdātī wa shiyaʿatuka ʿala manābir min nūr mubyaḍḍatun wujoohuhum ḥawli fi al-jannati wa hum jirā
english_text: you shall take charge of the reservoir of my inheritance, are the fulfilment of my religion, you shall execute and keep alive my "way of life", your friends and followers shall speak with authority, command respect and hold the torch of good manners and refinements, their faces will be all around me in the eternal land of peace and bliss (Paradise), in my close company.

arabic_text: وَ لَوْلا اَنْتَ يا عَلِيُّ لَمْ يُعْرَفِ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ بَعْدي وَ كانَ بَعْدَهُ هُدىً مِنَ الضَّلالِ وَ نُوراً مِنَ الْعَمى ، وَ حَبْلَ اللهِ الْمَتينَ وَ صِراطَهُ الْمُسْتَقيمَ لا يُسْبَقُ بِقَرابَةٍ في رَحِمٍ وَ لا بِسابِقَةٍ في دينٍ وَ لا يُلْحَقُ في مَنْقَبَةٍ مِنْ مَناقِبِهِ
transliteration: wa lawla anta ya ʿaliyyu lam yuʿraf al-muʾminun baʿdi wa kāna ba'dahu hudan mina al-ḍalāl wa nūran mina al-'amā, wa ḥabla allāhi al-matīnan wa ṣirā lā yusbaqu biqarābatin fī raḥmin wa lā bisābiqatin fī dīn wa lā yulhaqu fī manqabatin min manāqibihi
english_text: Were it not you O Ali, the faithfuls would not know the truth after me." After him (Muhammad) be (Ali) was the guide for the wanderers, a bright light in the blind darkness, the strong rope of Allah, and the right path, did not ever hold back kindness and compassion from the common people, nor ever made excuses or delay to give priority to the matters of religion, nor blew his own trumpet nor felt proud of his glory,

arabic_text: يَحْذُو حَذْوَ الرَّسُولِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِما وَ آلِهِما وَ يُقاتِلُ عَلَى التَّأويلِ وَ لا تَأخُذُهُ فِي اللهِ لَوْمَةُ لائِمٍ
transliteration: yaḥḏu ḥaḏwa al-rasūli ṣallá llāhu ʿalayhimā wa ālihimā wa yuqātilu ʿalā attaʾwīl wa lā taʾkhudhu fī allāhi lawmah lāʾimin
english_text: did the same thing the Messenger used to do, (Blessing of Allah be on them both and on their children) put an end to misinterpretation, did not lose temper, for the sake of Allah, if any one turned to mud-slinging and name-calling.

arabic_text: قَدْ وَتَرَ فيهِ صَناديدَ الْعَرَبِ وَ قَتَلَ اَبْطالَهُمْ وَ ناوَشَ ( ناهش ) ذُؤْبانَهُمْ فَاَوْدَعَ قُلُوبَهُمْ اَحْقاداً بَدْرِيَّةً وَ خَيْبَرِيَّةً وَ حُنَيْنِيَّةً وَ غَيْرَهُنَّ فَاَضَبَّتْ عَلى عَداوَتِهِ وَ اَكَبَّتْ عَلى مُنابَذَتِهِ حَتّى قَتَلَ النّاكِثينَ وَ الْقاسِطينَ وَ الْمارِقينَ
transliteration: qad watara feehi sanadid al-ʿarabi wa qatala abtalahu wa naawash dhu'ubanahum fāwḍaʿa qulūbahum aḥqādan badriyyatan wa khaybariyyatan wa hunayniyyatan wa ghayrahu_nna fa'aḍabbat ʿalā ʿadāwatihī wa akabbat ʿalā munābaẓatihī ḥattá qatala al-nākithīna wal-qāsiṭīna wal-māriqīna
english_text: He had thrown the proud tribal chiefs of Arabia into a fright, destroyed their heroes, attacked and dispersed their cavalries, because of which hatred and deep grudge took root in their hearts. Badr, Khaybar, and Hunain created jealousy and envy in them, therefore, united they joined hands to oppose him, and came out in great number to fight against him, till he destroyed all deserters, who had swerved from what was right, the shameless who deviated from true religion,

arabic_text: وَ لَمّا قَضى نَحْبَهُ وَ قَتَلَهُ اَشْقَى الاْخِرينَ يَتْبَعُ اَشْقَى الاَْوَّلينَ
transliteration: wa lammā qaḍā naḥbahu wa qatalahu ashqā al-ākhirīn yatbaʿu ashqā al-awwaliyn
english_text: while he was carrying out the important mission. Killed him a malicious criminal, a contemporary, serving the interest and following the doctrine of earlier impudent villians.

arabic_text: لَمْ يُمْتَثَلْ اَمْرُ رَسُولِ اللهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ فِي الْهادينَ بَعْدَ الْهادينَ
transliteration: lam yomtathal amru rasooli allahi sallallahu alayhi wa aalihi filhadeena ba'dal hadeen
english_text: An unparalleled and outlandish approach was applied to the directions of the Messenger of Allah, (Blessings of Allah be on him and on his children), concerning the "Guides" (Imaams), one after the other.

arabic_text: وَ الاُْمَّةُ مُصِرَّةٌ عَلى مَقْتِهِ
transliteration: wa al-ummah musirratun ʿala maqtih
english_text: The narrow-minded obstinate "ummah" did not care for and had ill-feelings towards him.

arabic_text: مُجْتَمِعَةٌ عَلى قَطيعَةِ رَحِمِهِ وَ اِقْصاءِ وُلْدِهِ اِلّا الْقَليلَ مِمَّنْ وَفى لِرِعايَةِ الْحَقِّ فيهِمْ
transliteration: mujtamiʿatun ʿala qatiʿati rahimih wa iqṣaʾa wuldihi 'illal-qalila mimmān wafā lir'iāti-l-ḥaqqi fīhim
english_text: Flocked together to pass up and deny his connection with his family, and pushed his children out of their way, but a handful of sincere faithfuls kept their promise and dutifully upheld the rights of his children;

arabic_text: فَقُتِلَ مَنْ قُتِلَ ، وَ سُبِيَ مَنْ سُبِيَ وَ اُقْصِيَ مَنْ اُقْصِيَ
transliteration: fa-qutila man qutila, wa-subiya man subiya, wa-uqṣiya man uqṣiya
english_text: Some were slain, some were held prisoners, some were sent to distant foreign lands, and they met face to face (when came upon) their destiny (martyrdom).

arabic_text: وَ جَرَى الْقَضاءُ لَهُمْ بِما يُرْجى لَهُ حُسْنُ الْمَثُوبَةِ اِذْ كانَتِ الاَْرْضُ للهِ يُورِثُها مَنْ يَشاءُ مِنْ عِبادِهِ وَ الْعاقِبَةُ لِلْمُتَّقينَ
transliteration: wa jara al-qadā'u lahum bimā yurjā lahu husnu al-mathūbah 'idh kānatil-arḍu lillāhi yūrisuhā man yashā'u min 'ibādihi wal-'āqibatu lilmuttaqīn
english_text: That which is given to each (of them) as reward of good deeds is the best recompense, since the earth belongs to Allah, and He gives it for an inheritance to whom He wants from among His servants, and the (good) end is for the God-fearing wise;

arabic_text: وَ سُبْحانَ رَبِّنا اِنْ كانَ وَعْدُ رَبِّنا لَمَفْعُولاً
transliteration: wa subḥāna rabbinā in kāna waʿdu rabbinā lamafʿūlā
english_text: glory to our Lord! Verily the promise of our Lord must be fulfilled;

arabic_text: وَ لَنْ يُخْلِفَ اللهُ وَعْدَهُ وَ هُوَ الْعَزيزُ الْحَكيمُ
transliteration: wa lan yukhlifallahu wa'adahu wa huwa al-`azizu al-hakimu
english_text: does not break His word, He is Almighty, Wise.

arabic_text: فَعَلَى الاَْطائِبِ مِنْ اَهْلِ بَيْتِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ عَلِيٍّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِما وَ آلِهِما
transliteration: faʿala al-aṭāʾibi min ahl bayti muḥammadin wa ʿaliyyin ṣallā allāhu ʿalayhimā wa āli
english_text: So be purified and refined by making known and remembering the choicest children of Muhammad and Ali, blessings of Allah be on them both, and on their children.

arabic_text: فَلْيَبْكِ الْباكُونَ ، وَ اِيّاهُمْ فَلْيَنْدُبِ النّادِبُونَ وَ لِمِثْلِهِمْ فَلْتَذْرِفِ ( فَلْتًدرِ ) الدُّمُوعُ ، وَ لْيَصْرُخِ الصّارِخُونَ ، وَ يَضِجَّ الضّاجُّونَ ، وَ يَعِـجَّ الْعاجُّوَن
transliteration: fal-yabki al-bakoon, wa-iyyahum fal-yandubi an-nadiboon wa limithlihim faltadhriʿifid-dumuʿu, wa liyasrukhis-saarikhūn, wa yadhijjadh-dhaajjūn, wa yaaʾij
english_text: The heartbroken, in tears, make their hearts bleed, together with them, the deeply moved perceptive men of letters describe their wisdom and liberality, as they themselves used to do, eyes of sensitive and thoughtful people are full of overflowing tears, their voices choked up with emotion; they cry out to protest against the injustice done, they call up dumb and insensate souls to stir and take notice.

arabic_text: اَيْنَ الْحَسَنُ اَيْنَ الْحُسَيْنُ اَيْنَ اَبْناءُ الْحُسَيْنِ
transliteration: ʾayna al-ḥasanu, ʾayna al-ḥusaynu, ʾayna abnā'u al-ḥusayni
english_text: Where is Hasan? Where is Husayn? Where are the children of Husayn?

arabic_text: صالِحٌ بَعْدَ صالِـحٍ ، وَ صادِقٌ بَعْدَ صادِقٍ
transliteration: ṣāliḥun baʿda ṣāliḥin, wa ṣādiqun baʿda ṣādiqin
english_text: whole good, one and all! The truth altogether!

arabic_text: اَيْنَ السَّبيلُ بَعْدَ السَّبيلِ
transliteration: ʾayna al-sabīlu baʿda al-sabīli
english_text: Where is the regular unbroken vital connection?

arabic_text: اَيْنَ الْخِيَرَةُ بَعْدَ الْخِيَرَةِ
transliteration: ayna al-khiyarah ba'da al-khiyarah?
english_text: Where is the on going sequence of desirable goodness?

arabic_text: اَيْنَ الشُّمُوسُ الطّالِعَةُ
transliteration: ʾayna al-shumūsu al-ṭāliʿatu.
english_text: Where are the clear source and spring of Light (vision and insight)?

arabic_text: اَيْنَ الاَْقْمارُ الْمُنيرَةُ
transliteration: ʾayna al-aqmār al-munīrah
english_text: Where are the lively vivid handsome faces?

arabic_text: اَيْنَ الاَْنْجُمُ الزّاهِرَةُ
transliteration: ʾayna al-anjumu al-zāhiratu
english_text: Where are the distinctly visible pioneers?

arabic_text: اَيْنَ اَعْلامُ الدّينِ وَ قَواعِدُ الْعِلْمِ
transliteration: ʾayna ʾaʿlāmu al-dīni wa qawāʿidu al-ʿilm
english_text: Where are the "know all the answers" scholars who communicated and made clear the religion of Allah?

arabic_text: اَيْنَ بَقِيَّةُ اللهِ الَّتي لا تَخْلُو مِنَ الْعِتْرَةِ الْهادِيـَةِ
transliteration: ayna baqiyyatullahi allati la takhlu min al-'itrati al-hadiyah?
english_text: The fundamentals of knowledge and wisdom! Where is the ‘Everlasting legacy of God"? (never ever is the "family of Guides" without One).

arabic_text: اَيـْنَ الـْمُعَدُّ لِـقَطْعِ دابِرِ الظَّلَمَةِ
transliteration: ʾayna al-muʿaddu liqaṭʿi dābir al-ẓulamah
english_text: Where is the impenetrable defense who broke the back of the oppressive tyrants?

arabic_text: اَيْنَ الْمُنْتَظَرُ لاِِقامَةِ الاَْمْتِ وَ اْلعِوَجِ
transliteration: ʾayna al-muntazharu li-iqāmati al-amti wa al-ʿiwaji
english_text: Where is the "awaited saviour" who will set the have-nots and the depressed on their feet?

arabic_text: اَيْنَ الْمُرْتَجى لاِزالَةِ الْجَوْرِ وَ الْعُدْوانِ
transliteration: ʾayna al-murtajā li-ẓalāṭi al-jawri wa al-ʿudwāni
english_text: Where is the "The Hope" who will put and end to tyranny and oppression?

arabic_text: اَيْنَ الْمُدَّخَرُ لِتَجْديدِ الْفَرآئِضِ و َالسُّنَنِ
transliteration: ʾayna al-muddakharu li-tajdīd al-farāʾiḍi wa al-sunnah
english_text: Where is the "preserved guaranty" who shall give new life to rule of law and refined way of life?

arabic_text: اَيْنَ الْمُتَخَيَّرُ لاِِعادَةِ الْمِلَّةِ وَ الشَّريعَةِ
transliteration: ʾayna al-mutakhyyaru li-iʿādati al-millati wa al-sharīʿati?
english_text: Where is the "Chosen in preference good" who shall raise the spirits of the people and give currency to justice and fairplay?

arabic_text: اَيْنَ الْمُؤَمَّلُ لاِِحْياءِ الْكِتابِ وَ حُدُودِهِ
transliteration: ʾayna al-mu'ammalu li-iḥyāʾi al-kitāb wa ḥudūdih
english_text: Where is the "hope-giving confidante" who shall make full use of the "Book" and define the sphere of action?
